title: The Bug and the Bun
lines: Bob got on the big bus.
A bun and a nut sat in the bag.
A bug got in and bit the bun!
"Do not dig in it, bug!" said Bob.
But the bug got a big bit of it.
A man on the bus got a cup.
Bob got the bug in the cup.
Bob got the bun. The bug got a bit.

questions.ask: What got in and bit the bun?
questions.listenFor: A bug. It is right there in the story. If your child guesses, point at the line with the word bug and read it again.

questions.ask: How did the man on the bus help?
questions.listenFor: He got a cup so Bob could move the bug. Listen for the cup - that is the turn in the story, and notice that Bob does the moving himself.

questions.ask: What was the problem on the bus? How did Bob sort it out?
questions.listenFor: A bug was eating the bun. Bob moved it with the man's cup. Lines three, six and seven.
